Note: printed '3p9 | 3p9 -> 1s5 | 4201 | 141±2 | 5%' : mean life 141 +- 2 ns (standard error of the mean) with an estimated systematic error of 5 %; electron excitation and delayed coincidence, line at 4201 A (NIST air wavelength 4200.7 A confirms the Paschen-to-Racah assignment). unc is the printed statistical error; unc_sys is derived from the printed percentage.
